Cost: Part of the Militech SPECTER
Class: EQ Machine Gun
Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Auto-Compensator, Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 5)

Only works mounted in the Militech SPECTER. Two modes, switched freely whenever you attack. Automatic: Autofire only, at ROF 2, and either half can be Autofire or Suppressive Fire; each Autofire uses 20 rounds. Hyper-Burst: Single Shot only, at ROF 1, using 180 rounds per attack; it ignores half the target's SP (rounded up), carries damage through Cover like an Explosive, and ablates 4 extra SP (5 normally, 6 with Armor-Piercing).

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > External Linear Frames).
